Author: Lily; Jacob5800 (BiSplanner fork)
Name: BiSplanner
Description:
Highlights gear, coffers, and materia needed for all your gearsets
Import from from Etro, Xivgear, or Teamcraft for easy setup

Highlights items needed for gearsets on:
    - Need/Greed Loot Windows
    - NPC Shops and Exchanges
    - Marketboard
    - Player Inventories
    - Item Tooltips

When melding materia, highlights:
    - Items to meld
    - Materia to meld to item

Automatically syncs gearsets with player inventory
Changelog:
## 0.3.0.4

- Improve disable/update cleanup: stop callbacks first, attempt remaining cleanup after an error, and ignore repeated shutdown calls.
- Fix the inventory event handler remaining attached after disabling the plugin, guard pending refreshes, and stop queued actions during shutdown.
